The **ADHD-behandlingspopulation** (ADHD treatment population) is a national demographic cohort in Denmark, comprising individuals who have entered an ADHD treatment package course (*pakkeforløb*) since the population was put into operation in the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]] on May 25, 2021 [^src9]. It includes both children, youth, and adults with ADHD [^src8], and serves as a foundational denominator and numerator for multiple national quality indicators monitoring the Danish healthcare system's ADHD services.

### Demographics and Regional Distribution
In the reporting period from April 1, 2023, to March 31, 2024, the treatment population consisted of 3,414 patients in package courses [^src9]. Demographically, boys account for 62% of the total population [^src9]. The distribution varies across regions; for example, [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] recorded 647 patients in package courses, while [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] had 841 [^src9]. Notably, [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] had no registered patients in the 0–5 age group within this population [^src9].

### Role in Quality Indicators
The population is central to evaluating both clinical processes and life outcomes across different age groups:
- **Medical Treatment:** [[indikator-6|Indikator 6]] uses the population to measure pharmacological treatment coverage. Nationally, 62% of ADHD patients in package courses were in medical treatment in 2023/24 [^src1]. For adults (18+), the newly introduced [[indikator-11|Indikator 11]] specifically tracks medical treatment within 120 days of starting the package course [^src8].
- **Educational Outcomes:** [[indikator-7b|Indikator 7b]] tracks the proportion of youth in the treatment population who pass the primary school leaving exam before turning 17. This rate was 65% in 2023 [^src1] and 58% for those turning 17 in 2024 [^src4]. There is stark regional inequality, with the highest pass rates in Region Hovedstaden (69%) and the lowest in Region Nordjylland (49%) [^src4].
- **Psychoeducation and Therapy:** [[indikator-5|Indikator 5]] and [[indikator-8|Indikator 8]] measure the initiation of psychoeducation. For adults, only 36% began psychoeducation within the 120-day timeframe, falling significantly short of the 90% development goal [^src5]. Similarly, [[indikator-9|Indikator 9]] tracks psychotherapy for adults, with a mere 1% fulfillment rate nationally [^src6]. [[indikator-10|Indikator 10]] assesses social support needs for adults within 120 days of treatment start [^src7].

### Governance and Systemic Challenges
The [[styregruppen|Styregruppen]] (steering committee) continuously evaluates the population's definitions and data quality. For instance, the committee has discussed whether to exclude a significant number of courses reported from child and youth psychiatric outpatient clinics from the adult population data to ensure accuracy [^src6]. The data derived from the ADHD-behandlingspopulation highlights systemic challenges, such as structural educational delays for youth [^src4] and an imbalance between non-pharmacological and pharmacological treatment components in the Danish ADHD intervention strategy [^src3]. It is distinct from the [[adhd-udredningspopulation|ADHD-udredningspopulation]] (ADHD assessment population), which tracks the diagnostic phase rather than the treatment phase [^src9].
